item.title: Comprehensive Overview of Withdrawal Sleeves and Specifications
item.description:
Engineering Reference for Withdrawal Sleeves: AH39, AH240, and AH241 Series
#

Withdrawal sleeves are essential components for mounting bearings with a tapered bore onto cylindrical shafts. This guide provides a detailed breakdown of the technical specifications for the AH39, AH240, and AH241 series withdrawal sleeves, supporting engineers and procurement specialists in selecting the appropriate sleeve for their application.
